presby.translation: abbr. presbyopia 老花眼; 远视眼; presbyopic 老花眼的; 远视眼的

presbyatrics.translation: [医] 老年医学, 老年病学

presbyope.definition: n. a person with presbyopia; someone who is farsighted resulting from the progressive loss with aging of the elasticity of the crystalline lens
presbyope.translation:
n. 老光者, 远视者, 老光眼者
[医] 老视者

presbyopia.definition: n. a reduced ability to focus on near objects caused by loss of elasticity of the crystalline lens after age 45
presbyopia.translation:
n. 老花眼
[医] 老视

presbyopic.definition: a able to see distant objects clearly
presbyopic.translation:
a. 老花眼的
n. 老花眼

presbyte.translation: 远视眼的(患者), 老花眼的(患者)

presbyter.definition: n. an elder in the Presbyterian Church
presbyter.translation:
n. 长老
[法] 长者, 祭司, 长老

presbyteral.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a presbyter or presbytery;
   presbyterial.
presbyteral.translation: a. 长老的, 长老制的

presbyterate.translation: 长老的职位, 长老的职权

presbyterial.translation: a. 长老的, 长老制的

presbyterian.definition: n. a follower of Calvinism as taught in the Presbyterian Church
presbyterian.translation:
a. 长老派的, 长老宗的
n. 长老教教友, 长老制支持者

presbyterian church.translation:
un. 〔宗〕长老会
[网络] 长老教会；基督教长老会；基督教长老教会

presbyterianism.definition: n. the doctrines and practices of the Presbyterian Church: based in Calvinism
presbyterianism.translation: n. 长老制, 长老派

presbyterians.definition:
plural of presbyterian
n. a follower of Calvinism as taught in the Presbyterian Church
presbyterians.translation:
(presbyterian 的复数) a. 长老派的, 长老宗的
n. 长老教教友, 长老制支持者

presbyteries.translation: n. 长老会, 长老会辖区, 内殿( presbytery的名词复数 )

presbyters.definition:
plural of presbyter
n. an elder in the Presbyterian Church
presbyters.translation:
(presbyter 的复数) n. 长老
[法] 长者, 祭司, 长老

presbytership.definition: n. The office or station of a presbyter; presbyterate.
presbytership.translation: n. （长老会的）长老；（英国圣公会的）牧师；祭司；发起人 (presbyter的变形)

presbytery.definition: n. building reserved for the officiating clergy
presbytery.translation: n. 长老住宅, 长老, 区会, 教区, 司祭席

presbytes.translation: [网络] 有年纪的；我这年老的

presbytiatrics.translation: [医] 老年医学, 老年病学
